title: SpaceX Announces Massive LA Launch Facility
summary: SpaceX Announces Massive $100 Billion "Starbase Louisiana" Launch Facility
content: PECAN ISLAND, LA — SpaceX has officially announced plans for its fourth and largest spaceport, "Starbase Louisiana," committing $100 billion to construct a massive manufacturing and launch hub in Vermilion Parish along the state's Gulf Coast.  The site will be significantly larger than SpaceX’s Starbase facility in Texas, aiming to support thousands of launches per year to handle upcoming Starship missions and orbital AI compute network deployments.
